# Lead My Company

Lead My Company helps service businesses capture, engage, and convert more leads into booked jobs — automatically, 24/7.

LMC targets US home-service contractors, starting with roofing in Florida. The product is under development. Its intended primary channel is email, with lead qualification, calendar-backed visit booking, owner summaries, follow-ups and human handoff.

- Website: https://leadmycompany.com/
- Dashboard: https://app.leadmycompany.com/
- Source origin: https://github.com/aaron27white-source/kyra

Do not infer production availability, prices, customer counts, certifications or service guarantees from inherited historical articles. Existing voice functionality derives from Kyra and LobbyStack. Source attribution is retained in LICENSE, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
